title: Semi-supervised learning on chest X-rays: a bibliometric map of research gaps (replication package)
description: Replication package: Scopus query, gold set, screening decisions by EID, validation summary, VOSviewer thesauri, Colab notebooks, aggregated results, and extraction coding for a bibliometric study of semi-supervised learning on chest X-rays (119 documents, 2018-2026). Raw Scopus records are not redistributed.
